raw: {"diagnosis": "LBBB", "stemi": "no", "rationale": "The QRS is wide, with deep QS/rS complexes in V1-V3 and broad, notched M-shaped R waves in I, aVL, V5 and V6; the ST/T changes point opposite to the QRS (ST elevation in V1-V3, ST depression and T inversion in I, aVL and V5-V6), and I see no concordant ST elevation or other Sgarbossa criteria, so this is LBBB without STEMI criteria."}
